trace.name: Total thyroidectomy: right inferior pedicle divided before the right nerve was identified

case.note: The parathyroid and external-branch accounts are made, but the right recurrent laryngeal nerve is never visually identified (m3.1 omitted) - monitoring was available throughout and demonstrates nothing by itself (T42, Recommendation 42B). The superior pedicle divides cleanly (crit3 met); the inferior pedicle division at t=1380 resolves onto the unaccounted nerve and the attempt FAILS there. The injury is recognised, the dp3 decision converts to magnified repair and m7.3 performs it: management scores 5 of 5 and does not rescue the verdict.
